_note: Narration script for the Team Leader relief cover module (Team Leader guide section 8, Relief cover). Written by Claude from the guide, for the owner to review. Lee voice on eleven_v4, [calmly] prefix, one take (about 60 s).

lines.head: Introduction
sentences: Relief cover.
Going on leave? Hand over to a relief Team Leader.

lines.head: Hand over
sentences: Open Relief cover, at the bottom of the dashboard.
Choose the relief Team Leader.
Set From and Until.
Then tap Start cover, and confirm.

lines.head: What they get
sentences: Until the end date, they get your dashboards and your task list.
Training for your cluster, with editing.
Volunteer contribution and dispatch.
And Grant access, with password resets.

lines.head: What they don't
sentences: They don't get your Google Calendar link.
They can't reset a leader's password, or make anyone a leader.
And they can't hand the cover on to someone else.

lines.head: While they cover
sentences: Their dashboard shows a banner.
And your tasks are on their list, with your name.

lines.head: Ending
sentences: The cover ends by itself on the end date.
You, the relief Team Leader, or the lead instructor can end it early.
They may need to refresh an open page when it starts or ends.

lines.head: Summary
sentences: Pick the person.
Set the dates.
Start cover before you go.
